cards.card_text: But now Moses changes the place to the open country, where a man overpowers a betrothed woman and lies with her.
cards.verse_text: But if the man encounters a betrothed woman in the open country, and he overpowers her and lies with her, only the man who has done this must die.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD speaks right to her: "So I will betroth you to Me…" Friend, after everything we heard about her lovers and the Baals, I did NOT see that coming.
cards.verse_text: So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.

cards.card_text: And He says He'll betroth her in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion, and in faithfulness.

cards.card_text: Then Paul pictures a man and his betrothed: if he thinks he's acting inappropriately toward her, she's beyond her youth, and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes.
cards.verse_text: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
